pull.body:
String.format() without an explicit Locale uses the system default locale, which can cause inconsistent formatting across different environments (e.g., decimal separators).

Added Locale.ROOT as the first argument to all String.format() calls in the tools/ and server-common/ modules. Added the necessary import java.util.Locale in affected files.

commit.message:
KAFKA-20646: Use Locale.ROOT in String.format() calls in tools/ and server-common/

String.format() without an explicit Locale argument uses the
system default locale, which can cause inconsistent formatting
across different environments (e.g., decimal separators).

Added Locale.ROOT as the first argument to all String.format()
calls in the tools/ and server-common/ modules to ensure
consistent formatting regardless of system locale.

Added import for java.util.Locale in all affected files.
